content: {"episode_id":"ep-05080","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"The clinical indication note documents recurrent syncope and presyncope in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary arteries. Because these symptoms are intermittent, cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) is indicated to correlate clinical events with underlying arrhythmias and evaluate for bradyarrhythmias or ischemic changes. We request reconsideration of the CO-97 bundling denial based on this documented clinical indication."}
